name: P6-practo
prompt: Below are 6 numbered screenshots of the Practo mobile app (Android) captured by the owner as a DESIGN REFERENCE (call them P1..P6 in the order provided). For EACH screenshot: (1) identify the screen (home, search, doctor listing, doctor profile, clinic/hospital page, booking flow, filters, orders, chat, health hub, account, etc.), (2) describe its visual design in depth: layout structure, list/card design, PHOTO usage (are doctor/clinic photos shown? circular avatars? sizes?), typography hierarchy (sizes/weights), the color system (what reads as primary vs secondary/accent color; approximate hex), components (chips, badges, pills, tabs, bottom nav, ratings, buttons, banners), spacing/density feel, (3) name the ONE design element that most makes this screen feel premium/desirable. This informs a redesign of another Indian healthcare booking app, so extract transferable patterns. Be concrete and honest.
verdict:
# Practo Reference Analysis — Screens P1–P6

All 6 screenshots are one continuous **Doctor Profile page** (Dr. Deepak A N, Neurosurgeon), scrolled through its sections. Shared chrome across all: sticky compact header (back arrow, ~44px circular doctor photo, name in bold black, "Neurosurgeon" subtitle in gray, bookmark + share icons on white), and a persistent dual-button bottom bar: filled **"Book Clinic Visit"** (Practo blue, ~#199CE8 / #21A6F0) + outlined **"Call Clinic"** with phone icon (blue text, white fill, blue border). This persistent booking bar is the single biggest conversion pattern.

---

## P1 — Doctor Profile: "Surgeries & Treatments" section
**Layout:** Single column, white. Big section heading "80 Surgeries & treatments" (~30px, bold, near-black #1F1F1F) with gray explainer subtitle (~18px). Then a simple list: rounded-square (~28% radius) light-lavender placeholder tiles (#D9DBE9-ish) with a flat gray hospital illustration icon, each followed by a bold treatment name (~20px), thin hairline dividers.

**Typography:** Strong hierarchy — huge bold heading, medium bold list items, muted gray supporting text. Feels like a content page, not a form.

**Color:** Blue reserved exclusively for CTAs (bottom bar). Everything else is black/gray on white — restrained.

**Photos:** No doctor photos in the body; illustration placeholders per treatment. Doctor avatar only in header. Bottom: cropped preview of the "Photos & Videos from Doctor" section.

**Premium element:** The **"See More" full-width outlined pill** that truncates a long list gracefully — progressive disclosure without clutter.

---

## P2 — Doctor Profile: Media gallery + Clinic Details
**Layout:** "Photos & Videos from Doctor" — horizontal row of two square (~110px) real surgical/clinic photos with muted speaker icons (video thumbnails), each labeled below with bold caption ("Surgeries & treatments") + gray count ("3 photos & videos"). Then a gray divider band (#F1F2F6) separates sections. "Clinic Details": clinic name bold ~24px, **green star + 4.5** (#12A852), gray "Multi Speciality Clinic", area name, "₹800 In-clinic fees" — with a real **hospital logo** (Medicover) right-aligned. Gray one-liner promo text. Below: "Hospital Photos & Videos" with one square interior photo + label.

**Photos:** Yes — real photos, square with slight rounding (~8px), no avatars; clinic logo as a rectangular badge. ~110–120px thumbs.

**Premium element:** **Real media with counts** ("31 Photos & Videos") — authentic photo evidence of clinic/surgery is the trust-builder; paired with the gray section-break bands that chunk a long profile.

---

## P3 — Doctor Profile: Hospital Excellence Rating card
**Layout:** A large elevated **card** (rounded ~16px, white on faint gray backdrop, soft shadow): heading "Hospital excellence rating" bold ~26px, and a bordered pill top-right: blue four-point sparkle ✦ + "4.5/5" (navy #1E3A8A-style blue). Explanatory gray paragraph, hairline divider, then three sub-ratings: bold label left, **progress bar** (navy fill on light track) + sparkle icon + score right (4.4, 4.0, 4.9), with gray one-line descriptions. Below the card: "Timings" — two bordered tiles ("Sun CLOSED" / "Mon-Sat 09:00 AM – 04:00 PM"), stubs of "Contact Clinic" / "Get Directions" outlined buttons.

**Color:** This screen introduces a **deep navy/indigo** (#2A3B8F-ish) secondary accent distinct from the bright CTA blue — navy = credibility data, bright blue = action.

**Premium element:** The **✦ "Hospital excellence rating" card with per-dimension progress bars** — a proprietary, audited-sounding score rendered like a premium report card. Most differentiated element in the whole flow.

---

## P4 — Doctor Profile: Timings + Location map
**Layout:** Timings tiles in full, then two half-width **outlined dark-border buttons** ("Contact Clinic" with navy phone icon, "Get Directions"). "Location" section: large rounded-corner (~12px) static map card with a navy pin inside a translucent purple-blue radius circle, light gray map style, orange POI labels; caption strip "Tap on the map for complete address". Then section heading "Doctor also practices at other centers".

**Design feel:** Outlined buttons with near-black borders (~1.5px) read as tactile secondary actions. The map radius circle is a thoughtful touch (approximate, not exact, location).

**Premium element:** The **map card with the confidence-radius circle** — communicates precision without over-promising; feels considered.

---

## P5 — Doctor Profile: Other practice centers + About intro
**Layout:** Multi-location card: bold area name "Kundalahalli", clinic name, green ★ 4.5 + gray type, "₹1200 In-clinic fees", **bright green "Next available 05:00 PM, Tomorrow"** (#1CA05F) — the urgency/availability signal — and a small outlined blue "Book Appointment" button. Partial clinic logo right. Divider band, then "About The Doctor": bold name, gray "Listed on Practo since December 2014", **circular doctor photo (~110px)** at right, icon-led credential rows: navy 🎓 degree line, navy shield "Council verified practitioner ⓘ", **orange diamond** "Association with top hospitals ⓘ".

**Premium element:** **"Next available" in green** — turns a static listing into a bookable, time-urgent one. Plus colored credential badges (shield/diamond) as instant-verify signals.

---

## P6 — Doctor Profile: About text + verification
**Layout:** Full About block: bold "About" heading, oversized decorative quote mark (gray), ~20px comfortable body text truncated with blue underlined "Read More" link. Then a **full-width outlined verification strip**: "Dr. Deepak A N has claimed their profile." (gray, underlined link) with a ✓ checkmark right — a bordered rounded rectangle. Below: "Education and achievements" heading + gray explainer.

**Premium element:** The **"claimed profile ✓" verification strip** — quiet, bordered, and it converts profile completeness into trust.

---

## Transferable patterns for your redesign
1. **Persistent dual CTA bar** (filled primary + outlined secondary w/ icon) on every profile scroll state — never lose the booking action.
2. **Two-blue system:** bright action blue (~#1FA7F0) vs. navy authority blue (~#2A3B8A) + green only for ratings/availability. Restraint elsewhere (black/gray on white).
3. **Section chunking with gray divider bands** + huge bold section headings (~28–30px) with gray explainer subtitles — makes a dense profile scannable.
4. **Trust stack:** circular doctor avatar in header, credential icon rows (verified shield, top-hospital badge), claimed-profile strip, proprietary excellence rating card with progress bars.
5. **Availability-first data:** green "Next available …" + fees + rating in every clinic card.
6. **Progressive disclosure:** "See More" pills, "Read More" links, labeled photo thumbnails with counts.
7. Honest honest caveat: the treatment-list placeholder icons (P1) are generic/dated; the media and rating cards (P2/P3) carry the premium feel, not the icon system.
